english.meaning: the Hong Kong Certificate of Education Examination, an old exam taken at Form 5
english.note: 會考放榜 means the results come out.

exampleSentences.english: Yes, yes. I’m listening to the news. The exam results came out last week, right?
exampleSentences.traditional: 有，有。聽新聞喇，喀。上個禮拜會考放榜吖嗎。

exampleSentences.english: The HKCEE only counts your best six subjects.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢會考都計你最好六科啫。
